title: A Latch-On-Resistant, False-Alarm-Gated Lead-Time Metric for Bearing Anomaly Detection — and What It Reveals About SCADA-Rate Logging
description: Code, result files and manuscript source accompanying the IJPHM manuscript 'A Latch-On-Resistant, False-Alarm-Gated Lead-Time Metric for Bearing Anomaly Detection — and What It Reveals About SCADA-Rate Logging'. The benchmark scores bearing anomaly detectors by lead time gated on a pre-onset false-alarm budget, and tests whether a SCADA historian's bin-averaged logging changes warning time relative to decimation, across four run-to-failure datasets (XJTU-SY, FEMTO/PRONOSTIA, University of Ferrara, NASA IMS) and one industrial case study. On the three multi-bearing campaigns the aggregate-minus-decimate difference is equivalent to zero within a pre-specified ±1 h margin; because those bearings are short-lived, the result bounds the effect at the scale of minutes. Every table and figure is generated from results/tables/ and checked by paper/verify_tables.py.
